title: pm-dispatch: a Tier H PR opened outside the relay gets no review request and no run row to check; state the per-author request rule and make the seat read requested_reviewers before the handoff
body:
Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-direct task; the maintainer's words are quoted verbatim below. Filed by `repo:cloud#2` (session `session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G`, account `os-zhuang`) through the project coordinator's relay. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: S, p2. Triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:skills` seat. One PR on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (Tier S in objectstack), with its contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

**Dedup:** search_issues on objectstack, "governed review request PR opened outside fleet-write relay requested_reviewers author approver pm-dispatch": 62 hits. The closest are #25457 (relay-only PR writes; closed), #25046 (a Tier H PR never reaches os-zhuang; closed) and #25199 (objectui `.claude/**` tier; closed). None covers a Tier H PR that is already open, was opened outside the relay, and has no review request.

## The maintainer's words (2026-10-25, Claude Code project "cloud", verbatim)

> 等我手工合并的，为什么没有按照 pm-dispatch 技能请求审核
>
> 我说的需要更新 github 上的项目吗
>
> 这个还识别账户的吗？hotlong 开发的会自动请审吗？

## What was measured (cloud, 2026-10-25)

- cloud#3255 and cloud#3256 are Tier H PRs (`.github/workflows/**` and `AGENTS.md`). Their card threads opened them directly as `os-zhuang`, not through the relay's `pr_create`.
  - The relay never saw them, so no request went to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, and no `governed review:` run row existed for the seat to check (SKILL.md: 「席位只核对 run 摘要 governed review 行,缺口才手补」).
  - Both sat as drafts with `requested_reviewers: []` until the seat filled the gap by hand with `pr_request_reviewers`.
- cloud#3268, opened through the relay's `pr_create`, got `hotlong` and `os-zhuang` requested automatically.
- The relay already distinguishes accounts: `governedReviewPlan` (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs:430`) requests every approver who is missing, except the PR author, whom it assigns instead. But that only runs on `pr_create` / `pr_ready` sent through the relay. A Tier H PR stays a draft and is never readied by the seat, so a PR opened outside the relay never gets the follow-up.
- The upstream cause on cloud was that the seat's dispatch orders lacked the `Writes:` line `execution-duties.md:129` requires ("PR 只经中继 `pr_create`"). That is a seat miss, recorded on the cloud side. This card is about the backstop, which the skill text does not spell out.

## What to change (text only)

1. **SKILL.md, near :198–200.** Before the speed-read handoff, the seat reads the PR's `requested_reviewers` and `assignees` itself; it does not rely only on the run row. A PR whose `user.login` is not `objectstack-fleet[bot]` has no run row by construction. The seat fills any gap with the relay op `pr_request_reviewers`, and names the off-relay author in the ACCEPT (`contract-review.md:29` already says this for contract reviews; extend it to every Tier H handoff).
2. **State the per-author rule as a table.** It is what `governedReviewPlan` already does:

| PR author | requested | assigned | who can approve |
|---|---|---|---|
| `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay) | `os-zhuang`, `hotlong` | — | either |
| `os-zhuang` | `hotlong` | `os-zhuang` | `hotlong` only (GitHub refuses a self-approval), or a direct human merge |
| `hotlong` | `os-zhuang` | `hotlong` | `os-zhuang` only, or a direct human merge |
| any other login (e.g. `baozhoutao`) | `os-zhuang`, `hotlong` | — | either |

3. **The speed-read's 「你要做的」 names the approver who can approve.** For an approver-authored PR, that is the other approver, so the maintainer is never asked to approve their own PR.

## Acceptance

- The two sentences and the table are in `SKILL.md` (or the reference it points at). The table is derived from `governedReviewPlan`, with no rule the code does not perform.
- Contract review PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The skill's own checks are green.
